{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''civilian transport''' was attacked by a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Unidentified Wroonian privateer band|band]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the raid, the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was destroyed by the privateers to stop it from sending out a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]]. One of the privateers, the Wroonian [[Dasha Defano]], later discovered that one of her [[Dasha Defano's friend|best friends]] had been aboard the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] at the time, and had been [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Defano's shame over her actions led her to leave the privateers and join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
